title: Relying on Allah While Job Hunting
paragraphs: After being unemployed for four months, Samir was starting to feel that his situation depended entirely on luck, applying to job after job with less and less genuine hope each time.
A mentor reminded him that while effort was his own responsibility, the actual outcome ultimately rested with Allah alone, and that trusting this did not mean he should stop trying his best.
Samir began applying with a calmer mindset, focusing on doing each application thoroughly rather than anxiously refreshing his email every few minutes hoping for an immediate response.

When an offer finally came through an unexpected connection he had almost forgotten about, Samir realized that his changed mindset had made the waiting period far more bearable, regardless of the eventual outcome.
